metadata.exposure: GSE80744 normalized expression, log1p, local OLS adjusted for PC1-PC5; same baseline exposure copied to both outcome environments
limitations: Application/data-contract demonstration, not independent causal validation.
Expression and flowering phenotypes share accessions; sample-overlap covariance is not estimated.
This local OLS re-analysis is not a replacement for published LMM/SMR/HEIDI results.
Baseline exposure is not an environment-specific eQTL; the GxE slope refers to heterogeneity of the outcome MR relation across FT10/FT16.
metadata.outcome: AraPheno FT10 and FT16, local OLS adjusted for PC1-PC5

warnings: GxE-IVW is a summary-statistics GLS model under supplied covariance assumptions.
MR evidence does not replace colocalization, functional validation, or gene editing.
No environment correlation was supplied; diagonal ratio covariance was used.
